payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results achieved by the Jasper model on various datasets, including LibriSpeech and Wall Street Journal.

claims.text: Jasper achieved a state-of-the-art (SOTA) result of 2.95% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder with an external language model.
Jasper obtained competitive results on the Wall Street Journal dataset after training on a combined dataset of 80 hours.
Jasper reported good results on the Hub5'00 conversational evaluation dataset, particularly for the Switchboard subset.
